2026_01_DAL_NYG.headline: Dallas can force New York to declare how much of its passing game Nabers can carry
2026_01_DAL_NYG.paragraph1: The Cowboys ruled reserve running back Malik Davis out, while the Giants list Malik Nabers as questionable despite a full week of practice. New York’s decision on Nabers matters because his availability changes how aggressively Dallas can tilt coverage and pressure toward the rest of the formation. The Cowboys can test that uncertainty by disguising safety help and forcing the Giants to win through secondary options; New York’s defense must answer by creating short fields before Dallas settles into a balanced offensive rhythm.
2026_01_DAL_NYG.model_rationale: Dallas has more ways to manipulate coverage if New York cannot feature its top receiver without restriction, allowing the Cowboys to dictate where the Giants must win.
